title: Florida House, District 113
what_it_does: Represents District 113 (Part of Miami-Dade) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Bruno Barreiro
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Home-health-care company executive and business owner; former Miami-Dade County commissioner (1998-2018) and state representative (1992-1998)
candidates.background: Bruno Barreiro, a Miami native born to Cuban immigrant parents, served in the Florida House from 1992 to 1998 and on the Miami-Dade County Commission from 1998 to 2018, including as chairman in 2006. He leads a home-health-care company and other family businesses and narrowly won the August 2026 Republican primary.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Barreiro supports the 2026 homestead property-tax amendment, saying retirees need relief to stay in their homes.
property_tax.quote: People need tax relief. It has become a very difficult thing, especially for retirees in Florida, to continue to afford living in their homes.

candidates.name: Gloria Romero Roses
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Real-estate and affordable-housing professional; small-business investor; former assisted-living-facility owner
candidates.background: Gloria Romero Roses, 55, was born in Bogotá and raised in South Florida. She holds an MBA from the University of Miami, has spent about 40 years in real estate, affordable housing and community development, ran an assisted-living facility until 2020 and has served as statewide vice chair of Ruth's List Florida and on the board of Catholics for Choice.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: She opposes the 2026 property-tax amendment, calling it a political stunt and saying eliminating property taxes is not a responsible solution.
property_tax.quote: Floridians deserve relief from rising costs, but eliminating property taxes is not a responsible solution.

sources.title: WLRN: Meet the primary candidates for House District 113
Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Gloria Romero Roses

housing.summary: She would speed affordable-housing construction with state financing for developers, public-private partnerships, small-scale infill and a lower income cap for workforce housing.

abortion.summary: She supports restoring access to safe, legal abortion and wrote a 2023 op-ed saying the six-week ban violated her Catholic values.
abortion.quote: A six-week abortion ban is effectively a total ban on abortion. Most people do not even know they are pregnant at six weeks.

candidates.name: Paola Vazquez del Mercado
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Write-in candidate: the name is not printed on the ballot; voters must write it on the blank line
candidates.background: Paola Vázquez del Mercado is a write-in candidate who says she has lived in the district for more than 30 years, worked as a political and credit risk broker at AON Risk and pursued land-banking investments in Edgewater from 2005 to 2016. Her Ballotpedia survey emphasizes public safety, corporate and international fraud, and environmental integrity.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

crime.summary: Vazquez del Mercado listed eradicating street violence and securing the downtown, Biscayne and Brickell areas among her three key campaign messages, saying the urban core faces a surge in public safety failures. She also called for stronger enforcement against financial fraud and human trafficking.
crime.quote: Eradicating street violence & securing Downtown , Biscayne and Brickell. Urban core facing unacceptable surge in public safety failures, Miami residents deserve to walk their neighborhoods without fear

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey - Paola Vazquez del Mercado

environment.summary: Vazquez del Mercado listed "Environmental Integrity" among her three key messages, calling for a halt to what she described as corrupt tree cutting and port mismanagement and for an end to corporate pollution. She also said protecting natural resources and preserving the community's environment is central to her campaign.
environment.quote: Environmental Integrity: Haulting corrupt tree cutting & Port Mismanagement. demanding comprehensive audit to eliminate bureaucratic waste, halt corporate pollution and restore transparency to Miami Gov.

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey - Paola Vazquez del Mercado

growth.summary: Vazquez del Mercado said Miami has been exploited by sophisticated financial and developer fraud and by shell-company structures, and she called for stricter transparency rules over corporate and offshore ownership to protect homesteads and neighborhoods.
growth.quote: Miami has been exploited as international hub for sophisticated financial and developers fraud, predatory shell company manipulation and LLC identity masking used to starve families and strip foreign investors local real estate equity.

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey - Paola Vazquez del Mercado

other_issues.title: Financial transparency and anti-fraud enforcement
other_issues.summary: Vazquez del Mercado said her central goal is stricter transparency over offshore corporate structures and LLCs, which she says are used for cross-border fraud, and she described her background in political and credit risk analysis as the basis for that work.

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey - Paola Vazquez del Mercado

other_issues.title: Gold and silver legal tender
other_issues.summary: Asked what policy areas she is passionate about, Vazquez del Mercado cited "financial sovereignty" and implementing Florida's gold and silver legal tender law, saying inflation and central banking are devaluing working families' savings.

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey - Paola Vazquez del Mercado
